purpose: Inclusive lower boundary for a percent coupon
setup: Reset SQLite; login as seeded user; set userId=2 and userToken from the login response
test_action: POST /api/apply-coupon with the user bearer token
verification: Check status, success flag, coupon_id, discount_amount and final_amount against FR-09
teardown: Do not reuse coupon usage state; reset SQLite before another run that depends on max_uses_per_user

purpose: Value immediately above the minimum for a percent coupon
setup: Reset SQLite; login as seeded user; set userId=2 and userToken from the login response
test_action: POST /api/apply-coupon with the user bearer token
verification: Check the percent formula without inventing a rounding rule not stated by the spec
teardown: Reset SQLite before a later case reuses SAVE10 for user id 2

purpose: Independent baseline for a fixed-value coupon
setup: Reset SQLite; login as seeded user; set userId=2 and userToken from the login response
test_action: POST /api/apply-coupon with the user bearer token

teardown: Reset SQLite before rerunning any usage-limit scenario
